title: parse: handle seccomp config propagation based on seccomp support
body:
`podman-remote build --security-opt seccomp=<path>` fails with no seccomp support because we build podman-remote without seccomp support and that leaks into the buildah parse package.

Fix this by not injecting a local seccomp profile without the tag. This ensures client configuration from binaries without seccomp support is not forwarded to binaries with seccomp support (e.g. from podman-remote to podman).

Additionally, offload CLI overrides validation to `setupSeccomp()` by passing through seccomp options without a check.

Ref https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29337#pullrequestreview-4841334993 https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29337

/kind bug
